message.content: {"hts_code": "4802.61.3000", "reason": "Uncoated paper and paperboard of a kind used for writing, printing, or graphic purposes weighing under 40 g/m² in sheets, but tissue paper is classified under Chapter 48 heading 4802 (uncoated paper) for lightweight paper, and printed tissue with a brand name falls under the subheading for paper weighing not more than 40 g/m² in rectangular sheets not exceeding 435 mm by 297 mm when unfolded; the 19 2/3 x 12 1/2 inch size (500 x 318 mm) exceeds the 297 mm limit so it is classified under 4802.61 for other sheets of paper of rectangular shape with any side exceeding 435 mm."}

predicted_reason: Uncoated paper and paperboard of a kind used for writing, printing, or graphic purposes weighing under 40 g/m² in sheets, but tissue paper is classified under Chapter 48 heading 4802 (uncoated paper) for lightweight paper, and printed tissue with a brand name falls under the subheading for paper weighing not more than 40 g/m² in rectangular sheets not exceeding 435 mm by 297 mm when unfolded; the 19 2/3 x 12 1/2 inch size (500 x 318 mm) exceeds the 297 mm limit so it is classified under 4802.61 for other sheets of paper of rectangular shape with any side exceeding 435 mm.
